name: Jibsam
title: Descendant of Issachar
summary: Jibsam was a son of Tola, who was a son of Issachar. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as one of the brave warriors in the tribe of Issachar. His significance lies in his place in Israel's tribal history as part of the lineage of Issachar.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Issachar
keyEvents.description: Jibsam is recorded as one of the sons of Tola, son of Issachar, in the family register of 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Counted among brave warriors
keyEvents.description: Jibsam and his clan were counted among the brave warriors of the tribe of Issachar. In David's time, there were 22,600 fighting men from the family of Tola.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Issachar
keyEvents.description: As a descendant of Issachar, Jacob's son, Jibsam belonged to one of Israel's twelve tribes, which received their inheritance in the promised land.

keyEvents.title: Issachar's Blessing
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Issachar, to which Jibsam belonged, received a blessing from Jacob on his deathbed, where the tribe was described as strong and hardworking.
